summary: Rhoecus was a centaur in Greek mythology who, together with Hylaeus, attempted to rape Atalanta in the wilderness. Both centaurs were killed by Atalanta with her bow. Apollodorus records the episode in his account of Atalanta's Arcadian upbringing.

sections.heading: Mythology
paragraphs: Atalanta, raised as a huntress and sworn to virginity, shot down Rhoecus and Hylaeus when they tried to force her.
Distinct from Rhoecus the Samian bronze-founder in Pausanias.
